paper.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention

mode_a_score_masking.purpose: quality validation that changes selection but does not physically reduce KV residency
mode_a_score_masking.claim_boundary: Mode A cannot support a GPU-memory-saving or concurrency claim.

mode_b_pd_disaggregated.purpose: production Path-P and Path-I offload, two-level recall, and concurrency measurement
startup_order: TGT_CONC=60 TGT_CTX=524288 CTX_LEN=1100000 MODEL=/models/deepseek-v4-flash CKPT=/weights/top3_R930_joint.pt bash high_concurrency/launch_decode.sh
CTX_LEN=1100000 SWA_RATIO=0.1 HOST=<PREFILL_IP> MODEL=/models/deepseek-v4-flash bash high_concurrency/launch_prefill.sh
mode_b_pd_disaggregated.reported_hardware: 8x NVIDIA H20 TP8 for the measured decode side; the released launch topology separately allocates GPU 0-7 to both P and D machines
mode_b_pd_disaggregated.claim_boundary: A faithful end-to-end deployment therefore needs two 8-GPU server allocations even though upstream result tables label the measured decode configuration as 8xH20.

public_release_contract_audit.decision: Do not claim that the public retriever checkpoint is connected to the released SGLang serving path until upstream publishes the expected PT checkpoint or an exact conversion plus parity test.

cost_proxy.warning: H20 availability and compatibility were not established. H100 SXM prices are a non-binding planning proxy, not evidence that the released H20 runtime works on H100.

required_before_execution: successful weights-only load through the pinned serving loader
architecture-shape validation against the pinned serving implementation
golden logit and selected-chunk parity against an upstream fixture

mode_a_quality_only.claim_boundary: Selection-quality transfer only; full KV residency prevents any physical-memory or concurrency claim.

paired_invariants: identical prompt bytes and token IDs
identical decoding parameters and random seeds
identical admission limits, load order, warmup count, and measurement windows
prediction equality or task-score deltas retained for every paired request
native and FlashMemory runs executed on the same pinned software and hardware allocation
execution_protocol.failure_policy: Every requested cell is terminal as complete, partial, or failed; failed and unsupported cells remain in denominators and may not be silently retried into a selected result.
artifact_contract: raw per-request timestamps, token counts, predictions, scores, and failure records
raw per-repetition physical memory, transfer, cache, miss, and controller counters
host, accelerator, network, container, driver, CUDA, dependency, model, retriever, and dataset provenance
SHA-256 digests for every raw artifact, implementation, checkpoint, dataset, summary, and generated table

execution_preconditions: Obtain the exact top3_R930_joint.pt expected by the released SGLang integration, or a maintainer-supplied deterministic conversion from the published safetensors file.
Verify converted/public checkpoint logits and selected chunk IDs against an upstream golden fixture before serving.
Provision one four-GPU machine for Mode A or two eight-GPU RDMA-connected machines for Mode B.
Capture immutable container, driver, CUDA, torch, sgl_kernel, tilelang, TVM-FFI, SGLang, NIXL, and UCX versions.
Run native DeepSeek-V4 and FlashMemory with identical prompts, decoding parameters, concurrency, and measurement windows.

blockers.reason: The published retriever artifact does not match the checkpoint format or architecture constants consumed by the released serving integration.
The 159.62 GB base tensor payload exceeds both physical and currently available unified memory plus swap.
The local host has neither TP4 capacity for Mode A nor two TP8 RDMA-connected servers for Mode B.
No public self-service H20 quote was found; the recorded H100 rate is only a cost proxy.

decision: Official FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4 remains unexecuted. Preserve this manifest as the P3 blocker record, run the frozen compatible-model RULER matrix separately, and do not mix its evidence with official V4 claims.
